description: This file implements Bluetooth Classic device discovery and RFCOMM file transfer in an Android application, encapsulating Bluetooth operations within the BluetoothShareTransport class and its nested BluetoothPeerSession class.

classes.name: BluetoothShareTransport
classes.description: Main class managing Bluetooth device discovery and file transfer over RFCOMM, providing an interface for starting discovery and handling peer sessions.

classes.name: BluetoothShareTransport.BluetoothPeerSession
classes.description: Nested class representing a Bluetooth connection session capable of transmitting files over RFCOMM.

methods.name: startDiscovery
methods.description: Initiates Bluetooth device discovery, checks permissions, and invokes a callback with a selected peer device.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Retrieves the BluetoothAdapter from the system BluetoothManager.

methods.name: hasBluetoothPermission
methods.description: Checks whether the required Bluetooth permissions are granted for the current Android version.

methods.name: sendFile
methods.description: Establishes an RFCOMM connection and transmits a file specified by a URI, including a simple filename header.

methods.name: pipe
methods.description: Transfers data from an InputStream to an OutputStream, reporting progress.
